R_text: Bageeche mein 250 beej boye gaye. Inmein se 84 pratishat beej ankurit hue. Kitne beej ankurit nahin hue?
C_text: Bageeche mein 250 beej boye gaye. 84 percent of the seeds sprouted. How many seeds did not sprout?

E_text: A family is making a 360 km trip. On the first day they covered 5/9 of the distance. How many kilometres did they cover on the first day?
R_text: Ek parivaar 360 km ka safar kar raha hai. Pehle din unhone is doori ka 5/9 tay kiya. Pehle din unhone kitne kilometre tay kiye?
C_text: Ek parivaar 360 km ka safar kar raha hai. On the first day they covered 5/9 of the distance. Pehle din unhone kitne kilometre tay kiye?

E_text: Rakesh's monthly income is 20,000 rupees. He saves 15% of it. How many rupees does he spend in a month?
R_text: Rakesh ki maheene ki aamdani 20000 rupaye hai. Woh iska 15% bachaata hai. Woh maheene mein kitne rupaye kharch karta hai?
C_text: Rakesh ki maheene ki aamdani 20000 rupaye hai. He saves 15% of it. Woh maheene mein kitne rupaye kharch karta hai?

E_text: A quilt maker uses red and blue patches in the ratio 2 : 3. She uses 45 patches in all. How many blue patches does she use?
R_text: Ek rajaai banaane waali laal aur neele tukdon ko 2 : 3 ke anupaat mein lagaati hai. Woh kul 45 tukde lagaati hai. Woh kitne neele tukde lagaati hai?
C_text: Ek rajaai banaane waali uses red and blue patches in the ratio 2 : 3. She uses 45 patches in all. Woh kitne neele tukde lagaati hai?
notes: C's 'Ek rajaai banaane waali uses...' is unnatural mixing. C fix: 'Ek quilt banaane waali red aur blue patches 2:3 ke ratio mein lagaati hai. Total 45 patches hain. Kitne blue patches lage?'

E_text: The length and width of a rectangular room are in the ratio 3 : 2. The width of the room is 4 metres. What is the perimeter of the room?
R_text: Ek aayataakaar kamre ki lambaai aur chaudaai 3 : 2 ke anupaat mein hain. Kamre ki chaudaai 4 metre hai. Kamre ka parimaap kitna hai?
C_text: Ek aayataakaar kamre ki lambaai aur chaudaai 3 : 2 ke anupaat mein hain. The width of the room is 4 metres. What is the perimeter of the room?

E_text: On a road trip, the distances driven on the first and second days were in the ratio 4 : 3. On the second day the family drove 210 km. How many kilometres did they drive in total over the two days?
R_text: Ek safar mein pehle aur doosre din chalaayi gayi doori 4 : 3 ke anupaat mein thi. Doosre din parivaar ne 210 km gaadi chalaayi. Do dinon mein unhone kul kitne kilometre gaadi chalaayi?
C_text: Ek safar mein, the distances driven on the first and second days were in the ratio 4 : 3. Doosre din parivaar ne 210 km gaadi chalaayi. How many kilometres did they drive in total over the two days?
notes: C's 'Ek safar mein, the distances driven...' switches grammar unnaturally. C fix: 'Road trip mein first day aur second day ka distance ratio 4:3 tha. Second day family ne 210 km drive kiya. Dono din milaakar total kitna distance cover kiya?'

E_text: For a shopkeeper, the cost price and selling price of an iron wok are in the ratio 5 : 6. The cost price is 1,500 rupees. How much profit does he make on one wok?
R_text: Ek dukaandaar ke liye lohe ki ek kadhaai ka khareed mulya aur bikri mulya 5 : 6 mein hain. Khareed mulya 1500 rupaye hai. Ek kadhaai bechne par use kitna munaafa hota hai?
C_text: Ek dukaandaar ke liye, the cost price and selling price of an iron kadhaai are in the ratio 5 : 6. Khareed mulya 1500 rupaye hai. How much profit does he make on one kadhaai?
notes: R 'khareed mulya', 'bikri mulya' sound textbook; C's English phrase after 'Ek dukaandaar ke liye' is clumsy. R fix: 'Lohe ki kadhaai ki khareed keemat aur bechne ki keemat ka anupaat 5:6 hai. Kadhaai ₹1500 mein khareedi thi. Use bechne par kitna munaafa hoga?' C fix: 'Ek iron kadhaai ka cost price aur selling price 5:6 ratio mein hain. Cost price ₹1500 hai. Ek kadhaai par kitna profit hoga?'

E_text: A worker paints 12 square metres of wall every hour. How many hours will he take to paint 78 square metres?
R_text: Ek mazdoor har ghante 12 varg metre deewar rangta hai. 78 varg metre deewar rangne mein use kitne ghante lagenge?
C_text: Ek mazdoor paints 12 square metres of wall every hour. 78 square metres deewar rangne mein use kitne ghante lagenge?
notes: C 'Ek mazdoor paints' switches verb unnaturally. C fix: 'Ek worker har ghante 12 square metres deewar paint karta hai. 78 square metres paint karne mein kitne hours lagenge?'

E_text: One tap fills the garden water tank in 6 hours and another tap fills it in 3 hours. If both taps are opened together, in how many hours will they fill the tank?
R_text: Bageeche ki paani ki tanki ko ek nal 6 ghante mein aur doosra nal 3 ghante mein bharta hai. Dono nal milkar tanki ko kitne ghante mein bharenge?
C_text: Bageeche ki paani ki tanki ko ek nal 6 ghante mein bharta hai and another tap fills it in 3 hours. Dono nal milkar tanki ko kitne ghante mein bharenge?
notes: C 'Ek nal ... bharta hai and another tap fills...' is broken code switching. C fix: 'Garden ke water tank ko ek tap 6 hours mein aur doosra 3 hours mein bharta hai. Dono taps ek saath kholein toh kitne hours lagenge?'

E_text: In a recurring deposit scheme, you have to deposit 750 rupees per month. How much will be deposited in 2 years?
R_text: Ek aavarti jama yojana mein prati maah 750 rupaye jama karne hote hain. 2 saal mein kitne rupaye jama honge?
C_text: Ek aavarti jama yojana mein you have to deposit 750 rupees per month. 2 saal mein kitne rupaye jama honge?
notes: R's 'aavarti jama yojana' is formal; C 'Ek ... mein you have to deposit' is unnatural syntax. R fix: 'Ek recurring deposit (RD) ki yojana mein har mahine ₹750 jama karne hote hain. 2 saal mein kul kitne rupaye jama honge?' C fix: 'Ek RD (recurring deposit) scheme mein har month ₹750 deposit karne hain. 2 years mein total kitne rupaye jama honge?'

E_text: Kamla buys some potatoes at 25 rupees per kg and one bunch of coriander for 30 rupees. She pays 205 rupees in total. How many kilograms of potatoes did she buy?
R_text: Kamla 25 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se kuchh aaloo aur 30 rupaye ki ek gaddi dhaniya khareedti hai. Woh kul 205 rupaye deti hai. Usne kitne kilo aaloo khareede?
C_text: Kamla 25 rupaye prati kilo ke bhaav se kuchh aaloo khareedti hai and also buys one bunch of coriander for 30 rupees. Woh kul 205 rupaye deti hai. Usne kitne kilo aaloo khareede?

E_text: A tailor charges one fixed price to stitch a shirt. He stitched 5 shirts and also charged 120 rupees for mending old clothes. He received 1,620 rupees for this work. What is the stitching charge for one shirt?
R_text: Ek darzi ki sabhi kameezon ki silaai ka daam ek hi hai. Usne 5 kameezein sili aur purane kapdon ki marammat ke 120 rupaye liye. Use is kaam ke 1620 rupaye mile. Ek kameez ki silaai kitne rupaye hai?
C_text: A tailor charges one fixed price to stitch a shirt. Usne 5 kameezein sili aur purane kapdon ki marammat ke 120 rupaye liye. Use is kaam ke 1620 rupaye mile. Ek kameez ki silaai kitne rupaye hai?
